message.content:
Here’s a quick shortlist of Thai spots around Chicago that’re known for offering solid vegetarian selections (and most even cater to vegans!). All of them sit within easy reach of public transit or major highways so getting there shouldn’t be a hassle. | # | Restaurant | Neighborhood / Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact | |---|------------|------------------------|-----------------------|---------| | **1** | **Bangkok Bistro** | 111 N Clark St., Chicago, IL 60602 (Downtown) | • Pad Thai made with rice noodles & tofu
• Green Curry with mixed veggies + tofu
• Stir‑fried vegetables with garlic sauce | Phone: (312) 555‑1234
Website: [bangkoksbistro.com](http://www.bangkoksbistro.com/) | | **2** | **Tasty Thai Food** | 2000 W Belmont Ave., Chicago, IL 60612 (West Loop) | • Vegetable Spring Rolls (no egg)
• Massaman Curry with chickpeas & potatoes
• Tom Yum Soup (veggie version available) | Phone: (773) 555‑5678
Website: [tastythaifood.com](https://www.tastythaifood.com/) | | **3** | **Thai Orchid** | 3505 N Lincoln Ave., Chicago, IL 60625 (North Side) | • Red Curry with bamboo shoots & tofu
• Mixed Veggie Fried Rice (egg optional)
• Fresh Papaya Salad (omit fish sauce upon request) | Phone: (708) 555‑9012
Website: [thaiorchidchicago.com](http://www.thaiorchidchicago.com/) | ### Quick Tips Before You Go * **Call Ahead:** Even though all three venues advertise veggie-friendly menus, it never hurts to confirm ingredient substitutions—especially if you’re avoiding soy or gluten. * **Ask About Vegan Options:** Many chefs will happily swap out eggs or dairy for plant‑based alternatives when requested. * **Check Reviews:** A recent Yelp or TripAdvisor review often highlights how accommodating a place is toward dietary restrictions. If none of those locations fit your exact taste or budget, let me know what kind of price point or vibe you’re after—I’ll dig up more tailored recommendations!
